name: Abu Saad
bio: The Abu Hanifa Mosque (Arabic: مسجد أبي حنيفة, romanized: Masjid Abī Hanīfa), also known as the Grand Imam Mosque (Arabic: جامع الإمام الأعظم, romanized: Jāmi` al-imām al-aʿdham), is a Sunni mosque and shrine, located in the A'dhamiyya district of northern Baghdad, in the Baghdad Governorate of Iraq.
